title.full: Protecting yourself from CPF phishing scams

summary.text: Do not share login details. Check the sender and links before responding or clicking.

details.heading: Official CPF contact channels
details.body: CPF calls come from 6227 1188. SMSes use the “gov.sg” sender ID. CPF email addresses end with @cpf.gov.sg or @e.cpf.gov.sg. The official WhatsApp account is “CPF Board Text Us” with the blue badge and phone number 6031 5753.

details.heading: When you are unsure
details.body: Check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline at 1799.

steps.name: Keep details private
steps.text: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details with anyone. CPF officers will never ask for them.

steps.name: Check the message source
steps.text: Check where the message came from. CPF Board uses official phone, SMS, email and WhatsApp channels only.

steps.name: Examine links
steps.text: Before clicking a link, check that its domain ends with “.gov.sg”. On a computer, hover over it. On a mobile device, hold your finger on it to see the full address.

steps.name: Report suspicious messages
steps.text: Report suspicious messages pretending to come from CPF Board through the CPF official hotline or Write to us. If unsure, check with ScamShield or call 1799.
